units.source_text: 他说：“闻吾婿近来寂寞无聊，笼闭家园，本拟前去访晤，闲话昔年琐事。

en.t: He said, "I have heard that my son-in-law has lately been lonely and dispirited, shut away at home, and I had intended to visit him and chat about trivial matters from former days.

units.source_text: 惟老夫已以多病为由，辞去官职，不问政事。

en.t: But I, this old man, have already resigned my office on the grounds of frequent illness and no longer concern myself with affairs of state.

units.source_text: 若由于一己之事，以龙钟老态频频出入，深恐外间蜚语谣传，谓我急于私而怠于公。

en.t: If, for a matter of my own, I were to come and go repeatedly in my feeble old age, I would deeply fear rumors spreading outside that I am eager in private matters but negligent in public duty.

units.source_text: 虽然已是隐遁之身，于世事可无须顾虑，然而权势专横，深可忌惮，因此闭门不出。

en.t: Although I am already retired from the world and should not need to worry about worldly affairs, those in power are arrogant and overbearing, and much to be feared; therefore I keep my gate closed and do not go out.

units.source_text: 闻吾婿即将离京，老年目睹横逆之事，甚是伤心。

en.t: Hearing that my son-in-law is about to leave the capital, and seeing such perverse injustice in my old age, grieves me deeply.
The path through this world is hard and perilous; even to speak of it is lamentable!

units.source_text: 即令天翻地覆，亦料不到有此逆事。

en.t: Even if heaven and earth were overturned, I could never have imagined such a rebellious outrage.

units.source_text: 身逢此世，真觉万事都无意趣了！”

en.t: Having been born into such an age, I truly feel that everything has lost all interest."
